offer.name: Facebook Business Page Setup Sprint
offer.promise: Your Business Page details, drafted into the Facebook setup and settings forms you already have open. You read the plan in the side panel and click Approve & Commit before anything is created, saved, or posted.

rules.status: Phase 5 (2026-11-25) verified the Business Dashboard, the /post/create composer, the Page About editors (Intro bio, Category, Links, Contact info, Details address), and the Add action button dialog against a logged-in Business Page; see docs/research/facebook-dom.md and test/fixtures/facebook/. The Page creation view (/pages/creation/) was verified from the personal profile the same day; it refuses while acting as a Page. Hours stay unverified: Facebook locks them until an address is saved.
rules.binding: Controls are found by visible label, aria-label, or placeholder. Facebook does not publish input names and its class names change, so the shim never depends on either.
rules.scope: Business Pages only. Outside the Page creation view, the page must name the pack's Page (as a heading, the dashboard greeting "Hi <Page>", or the composer prompt "What's on your mind, <Page>?") and show at least one Page-admin signal, or the plan refuses with no actions.
rules.commit: Create Page, Save, the action-button Save, and Post are commit actions. They run only after Approve & Commit for this exact plan hash.
rules.media: Profile picture and cover photo are attached by the person. The shim tracks them as a checklist and, when the pack marks one required, blocks commit until the file input has a file.
rules.secrets: Packs never carry passwords, two-factor codes, or access tokens. A sign-in page is refused.

essentials.name: Facebook Business Page Setup Sprint: Essentials
essentials.promise: Page name, category, bio, and the main contact details, drafted into the Page form you have open. Nothing is created or saved until you click Approve & Commit.

standard.name: Facebook Business Page Setup Sprint: Standard Business
standard.promise: Everything in Essentials plus address, hours, and the action button, drafted into the Page forms you have open. Nothing is saved until you click Approve & Commit.

launch.name: Facebook Business Page Setup Sprint: Full Launch + Post
launch.promise: Everything in Standard Business plus a launch post drafted into the Page composer. Nothing is saved or posted until you click Approve & Commit.

fields.notes: Verified at /pages/creation/: a <label> "Page name" wrapping input[type=text] inside role=form "Pages". No maxlength attribute, so the 75 cap stays unverified. Facebook reviews name changes on existing Pages.

Verified: input[role=combobox][aria-label=Categories] with aria-controls to a role=listbox of role=option rows; chips sit in span[role=list][aria-label="Selected values"] with "Remove <name>" buttons; the editor counts "n/3 categories". Each value must be an option Facebook lists; the shim clicks it and never invents one. On /pages/creation/ the same combobox is labelled "Search category" (one category, plus two extra), beside "Popular categories" buttons.

Verified on About > Intro > Edit bio: a <label> "Introduce yourself" wrapping <textarea maxlength=255>. Any view's own maxlength still tightens the cap when lower. The /pages/creation/ step has no bio field; the bio is set afterwards in the About editor.
Verified: About > Links > "Websites, blogs, portfolios" opens a <label> "Link" wrapping input[type=text], beside "Link description" (maxlength 150) and an "Add link" button.

Verified: <label> "Phone number" wrapping input[type=text], next to a separate country-code menu button (aria-label "Country code, US+1"). When the pack number starts with the picker's code, the shim drops the code and says so in the plan.
Verified: <label> "Address" wrapping input[type=text] in About > Details > Address. Hours stay locked until an address is saved.
Verified: City/Town is input[role=combobox][type=search], a typeahead that only counts a picked suggestion. The shim never types into it; the city is listed for the person to pick.
Radio group. Per-day opening times stay manual in v1 and are listed in the preview.

labels: Which button do you want people to see?
fields.notes: Verified: profile "..." menu > Add action button > Try It opens the dialog "Action button" with 15 div[role=radio] rows (title plus description), each holding an inner role=radio aria-labelledby its title: Book now, Sign up, Start order, Get tickets, Send message, Send WhatsApp message, Call now, Send email, Contact us, Learn more, Watch now, Visit group, Play game, Buy now, Reserve. It is a two-step wizard: the person clicks Next, and Page Push re-plans the link step.
Verified: step two of the Action button dialog is a <label> "Add website link" wrapping input[type=text]; Save stays aria-disabled until it has a value.

Verified at /post/create: div[role=textbox][contenteditable][data-lexical-editor] labelled "What's on your mind, <Page name>?" (the shim adds that label from the pack) inside role=form "Posts", in a role=main region whose title text is "Create post" (no heading element). No maxlength attribute, so the cap stays Facebook's published limit. Written through the browser input pipeline, never by setting DOM text.
Verified: div[role=button][aria-label=Post], aria-disabled until the composer has text; commit waits for it to enable. The Boost post and Add AI label switches beside it are never touched.
Verified: div[role=button][aria-label="Create a Page"], aria-disabled until the name and a category are set; commit waits for it to enable.
Verified: each About editor ends in div[role=button][aria-label=Save], aria-disabled until something changed, beside Cancel.
